destinations.title:
Dari goa hingga
pesisir Jogja.
destinations.intro: Kenali pilihan pengalaman bersama MAUA, lalu temukan kegiatan yang sesuai dengan rencana perjalananmu.

groups.title: Goa & vertical caving
groups.subtitle:
Jomblang, Ngeleng, Sumitro,
dan Macan Mati
paragraphs: **Goa Jomblang** menawarkan penurunan sekitar 60 meter menggunakan sistem hauling, dilanjutkan perjalanan melewati hutan purba menuju lorong yang dikenal dengan *Light of Heaven*. Cahaya matahari yang masuk melalui bukaan goa menjadi daya tarik utamanya. Untuk pengalaman yang lebih menantang, **Goa Ngeleng** memiliki jalur vertikal sekitar 90 meter, lorong horizontal dengan vegetasi alami, serta tantangan scrambling pada jalur keluar.

Di Pegunungan Karst Menoreh, Kulon Progo, **Goa Sumitro** menghadirkan penurunan sekitar 15 meter, formasi karst, dan sungai bawah tanah. Sementara itu, **Goa Macan Mati** menawarkan penurunan hingga 60 meter di dalam doline dengan vegetasi purba. Karakter goanya yang terbuka dan penjelajahan horizontal yang minimal menjadi pilihan untuk mengenal perlengkapan Single Rope Technique (SRT). Pilihan kegiatan untuk pemula disesuaikan dengan persyaratan paket dan pendampingan tim.

groups.title: Aktivitas air
groups.subtitle: Paddle board & cave tubing
paragraphs: **Kalisuci Paddle Board** mengajakmu menikmati sungai sepanjang sekitar 750 meter dengan air jernih berwarna hijau kebiruan. Tebing karst yang menjulang di kedua sisinya menghadirkan pemandangan alam terbuka sepanjang perjalanan di atas paddle board.

Untuk menjelajahi bagian bawah tanahnya, **Kalisuci Cave Tubing** membawa peserta mengapung menggunakan ban pelampung melalui lorong goa di kawasan karst Gunungsewu. Cahaya dari bukaan goa dan dinding karst menjadi bagian dari pengalamannya. Kegiatan dapat mencakup berenang dan melompat dari titik yang ditentukan, mengikuti paket serta arahan pemandu.

groups.title: Gunung & petualangan darat
groups.subtitle: Merapi & Nglanggeran
paragraphs: **Merapi Lava Tour** menawarkan petualangan jeep off-road di lereng Merapi sambil mengenal jejak erupsi masa lalu. Perjalanan melintasi jalan berbatu, area sungai, dan kawasan bekas aliran lava, dengan Gunung Merapi sebagai latar alamnya.

Jika ingin menikmati perjalanan dengan berjalan kaki, **Gunung Api Purba Nglanggeran** di Gunungkidul menawarkan trekking di antara formasi batuan vulkanik purba. Destinasi dengan ketinggian sekitar 700 meter di atas permukaan laut ini mengarah ke titik pandang dengan panorama perbukitan, persawahan, dan pedesaan Gunungkidul.

groups.title: Pantai & panorama laut
groups.subtitle: Pantai Timang
paragraphs: **Pantai Timang** memperlihatkan sisi pesisir Gunungkidul melalui tebing kapur dan deburan ombak Samudra Hindia. Gondola tradisional dan jembatan gantung yang menghubungkan tebing daratan dengan Pulau Timang menjadi daya tarik utamanya, menawarkan pengalaman menyeberang dengan pemandangan laut yang luas.

paragraphs: MAUA Project offers nature experiences in Yogyakarta and the surrounding area, with vertical caving as one of its main activities. Discover another side of Jogja through cave exploration, river activities, and outdoor adventures.

Travelling solo, with friends, or as a group? Choose an open trip to meet other participants, or a private trip for your own group. Explore the activities and facilities in each package to find an experience that fits your plans.

destinations.title:
From caves to
Jogja's coastline.
destinations.intro: Discover the experiences available with MAUA and find activities that fit your travel plans.

groups.title: Caves & vertical caving
groups.subtitle:
Jomblang, Ngeleng, Sumitro,
and Macan Mati
paragraphs: **Jomblang Cave** offers a descent of around 60 metres using a hauling system, followed by a walk through an ancient forest towards the passage known for the *Light of Heaven*. Sunlight entering through the cave opening is its main attraction. For a more demanding experience, **Ngeleng Cave** features a vertical route of around 90 metres, horizontal passages with natural vegetation, and a scrambling challenge on the way out.

In the Menoreh Karst Mountains of Kulon Progo, **Sumitro Cave** offers a descent of around 15 metres, karst formations, and an underground river. Meanwhile, **Macan Mati Cave** features a descent of up to 60 metres into a doline with ancient vegetation. Its open character and limited horizontal exploration offer an introduction to Single Rope Technique (SRT) equipment. Activities for beginners depend on package requirements and team guidance.

groups.title: Water activities
groups.subtitle: Paddle boarding & cave tubing
paragraphs: **Kalisuci Paddle Board** takes you along a river route of around 750 metres with clear, greenish-blue water. Towering karst cliffs on both sides provide an outdoor backdrop throughout the paddle board journey.

To explore the underground passages, **Kalisuci Cave Tubing** invites participants to float on inflatable tubes through caves in the Gunungsewu karst area. Light entering through cave openings and the surrounding karst walls are part of the experience. Activities may include swimming and jumping from designated spots, depending on the package and the guide's instructions.

groups.title: Mountains & land adventures
groups.subtitle: Merapi & Nglanggeran
paragraphs: **Merapi Lava Tour** offers an off-road jeep adventure on the slopes of Merapi while exploring traces of past eruptions. The journey passes rocky roads, river areas, and former lava flow zones, with Mount Merapi as the natural backdrop.

For those who prefer exploring on foot, **Nglanggeran Ancient Volcano** in Gunungkidul offers trekking among ancient volcanic rock formations. At around 700 metres above sea level, this destination leads to viewpoints overlooking hills, rice fields, and the Gunungkidul countryside.

groups.title: Beaches & ocean views
groups.subtitle: Timang Beach
paragraphs: **Timang Beach** reveals Gunungkidul's coastline through limestone cliffs and the crashing waves of the Indian Ocean. Its main attractions are the traditional gondola and suspension bridge connecting the mainland cliffs to Timang Island, offering a crossing with expansive ocean views.

featuredReviews.content: Seru banget!! crewnya ramah, care, dan sangat mematuhi SOP keselamatan. Dapet temen baru ciwi-ciwi seruuu

featuredReviews.name: Kharisma Hardiyanti
featuredReviews.content: So Much Fun! Pengalaman vertical caving di Goa Ngeleng bareng Maua Project unexpectedly seru pol! Dari awal sampai akhir kegiatannya exciting, menantang, tapi tetap fun. Guide-nya juga helpful dan selalu bikin kita feel safe selama kegiatan. Semua equipment udah prepared, jadi tinggal fokus menikmati adventure-nya. Dokumentasinya juga keren. Buat yang mau coba sesuatu yang beda, definitely worth to try!
